Meet your next racquet.

Bring more depth to your clears and more confidence to your attack. The Astrox 77 Tour combines a medium-flex shaft with Yonex’s Rotational Generator System to help you move from one shot to the next. A strong choice for players who like an attacking racquet with a more forgiving feel than an extra-stiff frame.
